values.meaning: Bonus Physical Damage from empowered attack
Bonus attack speed gained on cast
Duration of the attack speed buff / empower window

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack has an uncancellable windup and deals bonus physical damage to the target and surrounding enemies on hit.
mechanics.quote: Her next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the duration will have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies.

mechanics.claim: Completing the empowered attack refreshes the buff, allowing up to 3 total empowered attacks before it expires.
mechanics.quote: If '''Rek'Sai''' completes an attack, the duration is refreshed, for up to 3 total empowered attacks.

mechanics.claim: Queen's Wrath resets Rek'Sai's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Queen's Wrath {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rek'Sai's''' basic attack timer.''

mechanics.claim: The primary target's damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: ''Queen's Wrath's'' damage to the primary target is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: If the attack is dodged, blocked, or Rek'Sai is blinded, primary-target damage is nullified but the surrounding AoE damage still occurs.
mechanics.quote: When {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or {{tip|block|blocked}}, or if '''Rek'Sai''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, the damage dealt to the primary target is nullified, but the damage around her will still occur.

mechanics.claim: Prey Seeker's void bolt detonates on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: fires a void bolt in the target direction that detonates on the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Damage to the primary target of Queen's Wrath applies spell damage rules, while damage to secondary targets applies proc damage rules.
mechanics.quote: Damage to the primary target applies {{tip|spell damage}} and damage to secondary targets applies {{tip|proc damage}}.
